purpose: Add BTC options gamma exposure as a separately versioned derivatives-positioning context trial and compare it prospectively with the already-frozen ENA 1h, 8h trend, and cross-sectional forward agents without changing any strategy parameter or execution rule.

snapshot_definition.call_minus_put_gamma_proxy: call exposure enters positive and put exposure enters negative; this is an analytic call-minus-put proxy and is not observed dealer inventory
snapshot_definition.strike_aggregation: sum exposure by strike across expiries

balance_flip_proxy.definition: nearest sign crossing of recomputed call-minus-put gamma proxy across the frozen spot grid using each option's current mark IV, rate and time to expiry

anti_overfit_rules: Do not choose gamma thresholds from strategy PnL.
Do not change frozen ENA, 8h trend, or cross-sectional parameters because of gamma results.
Do not backfill historical GEX from current open interest or current implied volatility.
Do not label the call-minus-put proxy as observed dealer positioning.
Do not promote a gamma condition from the highest retrospective PF or expectancy.
Do not weaken fees, spread, funding, slippage, risk, holdout, or claim boundaries.
Do not combine gamma with another condition until incremental information is separately demonstrated under a predeclared protocol.
